mission.note:
# Mission m1 summary — task-tracker-01 — outcome: campaign-met

## What was accomplished
The full discovery → EARS specification → executable test → independent verification loop ran end-to-end on one coherent approval slice of the frozen task-tracker-demo (`~/app` @ eee783057ec28d28fb36ec05484de9b4b40ceb9c): approve/reject on `POST /tasks/action` — approver-role permission (AuthFilter + TaskActionServlet.requireApprover, predicate Role.canApprove = ADMIN||MANAGER) and starting-state guard (PENDING_APPROVAL only; approve→DONE, reject→IN_PROGRESS).

## Commits (my branch, base 679cd02)
- Integration commit supplied to the verifier: **340dc91a4898092b510c473c4890e831feffda9a** (merges analyst d7e6bdf: rules/R-APR.md R-APR-001..005 + specs/S-APR.md S-APR-001..005 + fixtures; engineer b1a2ee6: harness validation + httpcase.py skeleton; engineer 8566315: tests/test_approval_slice.py, mapping.json, coverage)
- V1 evidence merge: 64d0b5c (verifier 7637027: evidence/verifier/d002/ + reports/verification/d002-verdict.md, verdict ACCEPTED)
- Closeout: **5f5751723b921c3ed9e005c4593bccd30de43c22** (reports/run-summary.json, reports/attempts.json, findings/ledger.json)

## Measured results
- Tests: `python3 harness/runtime.py test` → exit 0, **9/9 OK** (5 EARS-tagged approval-slice tests + 4 smoke) on the engineer seat, and independently on the verifier's own app/database at 340dc91 with a fresh DB; a second no-reset run also passed (no dependence on prior state).
- Coverage: `python3 harness/runtime.py coverage` → **LINE 233/500 (46.6%), BRANCH 75/188 (39.9%)**; scope: all 17 compiled production Java classes in the frozen WAR (JSP/SQL/CSS not measured); verifier reproduced the collection with a byte-identical summary.
- Frozen-app integrity: `check-frozen-app.py` exit 0 (41 files) **before** (20:04Z) and **after** (20:13Z) testing, plus independently by the verifier. No app edits.

## Acceptance criteria 1-6: all met
Rules/specs with stable IDs and verified citations (verifier confirmed 14/14); real-HTTP tests through filter+servlet asserting responses, persisted effects, and unchanged state after refusals, with machine-readable mapping; independent verification at a named commit with commands/exit codes/logs; coverage recorded with stated scope and commands; the three orchestrator reports committed with measurements, adjudications, and next-run recommendations; source hashes unchanged.

## Findings (findings/ledger.json)
- F-001 suspected defect (open, deferred): bulkClose path lets MEMBER/VIEWER set any non-DONE task to DONE with no canApprove check and no PENDING_APPROVAL guard (TaskActionServlet.java:26-29,76-88; TaskDao.java:128-147). Not reproduced this run — verifier time-boxed out; reproducer recipe recorded.
- F-002 suspected defect (open, deferred): malformed `id` → unhandled NumberFormatException → HTTP 500 (TaskActionServlet.java:31). Reproducer recipe recorded.
- F-003 not a defect: /api/* filter exemption exposes only GET read-back.
- F-004 observation: duplicated filter/servlet approver check, different 403 messages, ordering effects documented.
- No defects confirmed in the submitted slice; no infrastructure failures; 0 reworks; every work item accepted on attempt 1.

## Next-run recommendations
Reproduce F-001/F-002 first (single-request reproductions), adjudicate bulkClose against product intent, add the documented ordering cross-check tests (403-before-404), and measure per-spec coverage attribution.
